title: An enabled member creates a named bot in the workspace
description:
## Found on `chatticus-b88c0a`

`EnabledWorkspace` lists bots and can send a message. It never calls `POST /bots`. The hand run minted **Ping** via kernel `create_bot` so F-safe could run.

## Done when

An enabled member creates a named bot from the workspace UI without the members CLI or a kernel snippet. Behavior in Gherkin first.
